div.div: p0/p7 = downstream OC slaves (different NICs and different LANs), p1/p2 = BC1 master/slave ports (same NIC), p5/p6 = BC2 master/slave ports (same NIC, different from BC1), p3/p4 = the grandmaster's 2 ports (same node, same NIC). Each GM port is directly connected to one BC slave port; each BC master port serves its own downstream slave.
